## Detailed Project Catalog

### 1. RAGReader (NextAI Hackathon Submission)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/thirza258/RagReader
- **Live Demo**: https://rag.nevatal.tech/
- **Devpost**: https://devpost.com/software/ragreader-kauodp
- **Summary**: An interactive evaluation and benchmarking platform created to compare, analyze, and identify the most effective Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) configuration for custom document collections.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Scalable asynchronous document ingestion and parsing pipeline using Django REST Framework, Celery, and Docker.
  - Multi-pipeline dense retrieval benchmarking supporting OpenAI embedding models via OpenRouter and LangChain text chunkers.
  - Integration of cross-encoder rerankers (MiniLM-L2) alongside LLMs from Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), and OpenAI.
  - Vector embedding persistence, metadata filtering, and chunk storage powered by ChromaDB.
  - BERTScore and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation frameworks for objective quantitative scoring.
  - Modern reactive user interface built with React, Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Tech Stack**: Django REST Framework, ChromaDB, Celery, Redis, Docker, LangChain, OpenRouter, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Mistral, Cross-Encoder MiniLM-L2, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GitHub Actions.

### 2. Multi-Hop Corrective with Reranker RAG Pipeline (CRAG)
- **Context**: Final Academic Research Project, Universitas Indonesia
- **Summary**: Advanced multi-hop reasoning architecture designed to solve multi-step question answering while aggressively mitigating model hallucinations and retrieval noise.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Hybrid retrieval combining dense vector embeddings and BM25 sparse keyword searches.
  - Corrective RAG (CRAG) mechanism dynamically assessing relevance of retrieved contexts before passing to generation.
  - Quantitative benchmarking with Hit Rate, Mean Average Precision (MAP), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), RAGAS Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, and BERTScore.
  - Low-latency backend infrastructure containerized with Docker.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Django REST Framework, ChromaDB, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, DeepSeek LLMs, OpenAI, RAGAs, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

### 3. Nevatal
- **Repository**: https://github.com/thirza258/nevatal
- **Live Demo**: https://chat.nevatal.tech/
- **Devpost**: https://devpost.com/software/chattywhole
- **Context**: Google Chrome Built-in AI Challenge 2025 Submission
- **Summary**: Full-stack AI workspace integrating prompt engineering, text manipulation utilities, document RAG, and multimodal image synthesis.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Gemini embeddings and prompt orchestration for context-aware Q&A over local documents.
  - Production-ready Django REST Framework backend with PostgreSQL.
  - Responsive frontend interface built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
  - Docker Compose setup enabling simple self-hosting with personal API keys.
- **Tech Stack**: Django REST Framework, Google Gemini API, OpenRouter, PostgreSQL, Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Docker.

### 4. Ollie Chatbot (OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia)
- **Context**: Enterprise Internship Project at OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia
- **Summary**: Intelligent internal HR and employee assistant incorporating biometrics and conversational AI.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - FaceNet-based biometric facial recognition for secure automated employee authentication.
  - Indonesian text-to-speech utilizing a fine-tuned xTTS model and speech-to-text with local OpenAI Whisper.
  - Fast knowledge retrieval across HR policies using Faiss vector indexes and PostgreSQL.
  - Natural conversation synthesis powered by OpenAI GPT and locally hosted Ollama instances.
- **Tech Stack**: FaceNet, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, xTTS, OpenAI Whisper, Faiss, PostgreSQL, OpenAI GPT, Ollama.

### 5. 5S AI Camera (OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia)
- **Context**: Enterprise Industrial Computer Vision Project at OPPO
- **Summary**: Real-time factory floor compliance monitoring system based on 5S lean manufacturing principles.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Image classification using ConvNeXt architecture trained with PyTorch.
  - Vision Language Models (Ollama Gemma Vision & LLaVA) and OwlViT for automated object detection and violation description generation.
  - Operator dashboard built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for live video feeds and violation alerts.
- **Tech Stack**: ConvNeXt, PyTorch, Ollama Gemma Vision, LLaVA VLM, OwlViT, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

### 6. 5Why AI Application (OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia)
- **Context**: Quality Engineering & Root Cause Analysis Tool
- **Summary**: Automated "5 Whys" root cause analysis system extracting insights from historical factory incident logs.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Dense and Sparse hybrid RAG utilizing Faiss vector search and MiniLM embeddings.
  - DeepSeek LLM reasoning pipelines for contextual diagnostic tree generation.
  - High-performance asynchronous backend developed with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
  - Sleek modern interface built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, Python, Faiss, MiniLM, DeepSeek LLM, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.

### 7. KJRI New York Chatbot (Maleo AI) & PFN Chatbot (Aether AI)
- **Context**: AI Consultancy & Government Client Engagements at Aether AI
- **Summary**: Production conversational assistants for the Indonesian Consulate General in New York and Produksi Film Negara (PFN).
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Automated consular service inquiries and film archives document crawling.
  - Document chunking, vector indexing with Vectorshift, and GPT-powered RAG.
  - Scalable backend APIs deployed with FastAPI.
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, Python, Vectorshift, OpenAI GPT, RAG.

### 8. Pasal Voice Assistant
- **Summary**: An open, self-hosted, privacy-respecting Indonesian voice assistant.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Indonesian TTS via Facebook MMS-TTS and STT via OpenAI Whisper.
  - Local inference with Gemma 3 and GemmaEmbedding running under Ollama.
  - Persistent vector storage using self-hosted ChromaDB in Docker.
- **Tech Stack**: Ollama, Gemma, ChromaDB, OpenAI Whisper, Facebook MMS, PyTorch, Transformers, Docker.

### 9. URL Shortener Platform
- **Repository**: https://github.com/thirza258/freecodecamp_url_shortener
- **Live Demo**: https://url.nevatal.tech/
- **Summary**: High-performance URL shortener with rate limiting, slug generation, analytics tracking (clicks, referrers, user agents), and Docker Compose deployment.
- **Tech Stack**: Django, PostgreSQL 16, Redis, Docker.

### 10. ChattyDesk
- **Summary**: Cross-platform desktop application unifying multiple LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GPT, Mistral) in a single workflow.
- **Tech Stack**: Electron, React, TypeScript, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, DigitalOcean.

### 11. Integrated Information Systems (SIT) (BEM Universitas Indonesia)
- **Summary**: Organization portal for 200+ student leaders managing finances, reimbursements, publications, and integrated LINE Messaging API bot.

### 12. SiInven & Open Recruitment & LPJ Online (BEM Fasilkom UI / Academic)
